BRITTLE_CONSTRAINTS.pattern: REQUIRED: result validation pattern — check File.Exists(outputPath) and result?.ResultCollection?.Count > 0
BRITTLE_CONSTRAINTS.reason_for_removal: Over-constrained: checked for exact literal string in generated code. LLM wrote semantically equivalent validation using different variable names or whitespace. Caused generation failure for all 3 image types in run 3 (4/11 generated vs 10/11 after removal).
BRITTLE_CONSTRAINTS.lesson: REQUIRED constraints on implementation patterns (validation code, not API calls) are brittle. The pattern checked exact string 'File.Exists(outputPath) and result?.ResultCollection?.Count > 0' which LLM never wrote verbatim.
BRITTLE_CONSTRAINTS.replacement: No replacement needed — build+runtime exit code validates correctness. No REQUIRED constraint should enforce validation code style.

GAPS_ADDRESSED_IN_SPRINT10.observed_failure: Jpeg used output.pdf instead of output.jpg; Tiff used output.tif instead of output.tiff
GAPS_ADDRESSED_IN_SPRINT10.sprint10_fix: Added REQUIRED: \"output.jpg\" and REQUIRED: \"output.tiff\" literal-string constraints
GAPS_ADDRESSED_IN_SPRINT10.validator_change: code_generator.py _validate_code_from_constraints extended to check literal strings for REQUIRED patterns without parentheses
GAPS_ADDRESSED_IN_SPRINT10.effectiveness_prediction: HIGH — deterministic failures; literal string check is exact and unambiguous

REDUNDANT_CONSTRAINTS.note: After Sprint 10 fix, AddOutput constraint checks for method call presence; filename constraint checks for exact filename. Together they enforce both method pattern AND correct filename. Not redundant — complementary.

Html.repair_convergence_rate: 2/4 runs (50%) — Html fixture pattern is complex (HTML file vs PDF file)

governance_rules.rule_1: REQUIRED constraints MUST check for API method calls or using directives — never for implementation patterns (validation code style, variable names, whitespace).
governance_rules.rule_2: REQUIRED literal-string constraints (no parentheses) are permitted for filename/value enforcement where exact string must appear in generated code.
governance_rules.rule_3: FORBIDDEN constraints are exempt when the required LowCode call is present — supporting/fixture code is not a violation.
governance_rules.rule_4: A constraint that causes >25% generation failure rate across multiple runs must be reviewed as potentially over-constrained.
governance_rules.rule_5: Constraint effectiveness must be re-evaluated after every 4 pilot runs.

lane2_verdict: CONSTRAINT_EFFECTIVENESS_GOVERNANCE_ESTABLISHED — 11 types audited, 5 HIGH_VALUE, 1 BRITTLE (removed), 2 GAPS addressed in Sprint 10. Governance rules formalized. Literal-string check capability added.
